# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old, though he looks younger  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, Massachusetts, United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul is small for his age, looking more like eight years old. He has delicate, refined facial features framed by a halo of chestnut brown curly hair, and dark blue eyes that match his father's. His bright, expressive smile illuminates his entire face.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)_

## Personality

Paul is an extraordinarily imaginative, sensitive, and intelligent boy who is widely regarded as a genius. He possesses a sober, meditative disposition and acts like a perfect gentleman, keeping himself clean and behaving politely. Though quiet and fond of solitary daydreaming, he is manly, fair-minded, and easily holds his own with other children in school games.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c8 P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036)_

- Imaginative and creative  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- Polite and gentlemanly  <sub>[v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052)</sub>

- Manly  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Abilities

- Vivid storytelling and world-building  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- Capable fighter and athlete in schoolyard games  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Goals

- To honor the memory of his deceased mother  <sub>[v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>
- To grow as tall and manly as his father  <sub>[v2 c27 P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)</sub>

## History

After his mother passed away, Paul moved from Boston to Avonlea to live with his paternal grandmother. On his first day attending the Avonlea school, he quickly formed a deep bond of friendship with his teacher, Anne Shirley, who recognized him as a kindred spirit and a genius. Lacking local playmates near his home on the shore road, Paul invented vivid imaginary friends—such as Nora of Andrews' Cove and the Twin Sailors—with whom he shared grand adventures. At school, he proved both gentle and capable, defending his American patriotism in a drawn fight against St. Clair Donnell and later protecting younger students like Davy Keith. When Prillie Rogerson mocked his naturally curly hair, Paul dunked his head into a spring to prove it was natural, accidentally falling in completely. During a trip with Anne to Grafton, he met Miss Lavendar Lewis and immediately took a liking to her. Later, his father unexpectedly visited Avonlea, leading to a joyful reunion for Paul.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P26](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Irving  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- His mother died three years prior to his arrival in Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004)</sub>
- Moved to Prince Edward Island to live with his grandmother on the shore road  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Quotes

> Please, teacher, I found these in Mr. Wright’s field, and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . . I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> You see, teacher, it’s just three years today since my little mother died. It’s such a long, long time but it hurts just as much as ever . . . and I miss her just as much as ever.  <sub>[v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004)</sub>

> Mrs. Lynde, father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022)</sub>

> I can’t do it, Grandma. I don’t really know if I can eat anything. I feel as if there was a dreadful lump in my throat.  <sub>[v2 c26 P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Shirley, you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here!  <sub>[v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)</sub>
